_shift_notes_S77e_step4: Classification (i) FIXTURE-WAS-WRONG — hand-written scenario had old-schema values that the current builder cannot produce. Corrections: (1) purchaseType 'Direct Sale' → 'direct_from_builder' (raw V2 option value); (2) propertyType 'Independent House' REMOVED (no V2 schema question binds propertyType); (3) constructionStatus 'Under Construction' → 'Flat' (builder maps constructionType Flat/House/Floor answer → constructionStatus; 'Under Construction' was a PropertyStage value, not a constructionType); (4) propertyStage 'Superstructure' → 'Under Construction' (valid V2 PropertyStage option; 'Superstructure' was an older constructionProgress value on an orphaned question); (5) carpetArea/carpetAreaUnit/carpetAreaRaw added from propertyCharacter page; (6) reraRegistrationStatus REMOVED — q5 defined in propertyCondition.ts but excluded from getPropertyConditionQuestions() export, so not surfaced on any page; (7) residenceSameAsProperty true added — from residenceOptionSame: 'Yes' on tellUs custom page; (8) assessmentStatus/auctionPropertyStatus/registryTimeline added from their respective pages; (9) documentationReadiness added with valid PLANNED_AUTHORITY option values (SALE_DEED/BUILDER_AGREEMENT/ALLOTMENT_LETTER); (10) ocCcAvailable/municipalApproval/isPossessionOfferedByAuthority NOT added — all require RTM or direct_from_authority, all hidden for UC + direct_from_builder + Flat; (11) legal chain (titleChainStatus/encumbranceCertStatus/successionStatus/revenueRecordMutation) NOT added — all require non-PLANNED_AUTHORITY area types; (12) grossIncome/netIncome REMOVED from applicant — Self-employed(Professional) path in applicantPayload.ts does not set those (only Salaried path does); (13) hasBarCouncilChamber NOT added — applicant's isLawyerBarCouncil not set (CA is not a lawyer).
